events.name: The Draconid at the Fire
events.intro: A rest on high ground. Somebody's already sitting at your fire, toasting something on a stick. A Whismur sleeps in her lap. Zinnia: "Hi. I let myself in. You don't own the hill." Zinnia: "I've been watching you watch them. Red hats want more land. Blue hats want more sea. You walked straight down the middle like you'd smelled something." Zinnia: "My people have a story. Land and sea fight. They always fight. And every time, what stops them comes from up there." She points with the stick. The sky's very clear. Zinnia: "Nobody's on the sky's side. No hats. No boats. Funny, that."

success.text: Zinnia: "Mm. Somebody." She hands over the stick. Zinnia: "It needs a name. And you'll need people. Good ones, for once."
Zinnia: "I'm the last of a lot of things. I'm not a joiner. But I'll come to the meetings and criticise."
Zinnia: "Fair." She finishes her snack and goes. She'll ask once more.

events.name: The Draconid at the Fire
events.intro: Zinnia: "Me again. You saw that one too. Still not starting a team?"

success.text: Zinnia: "Mm. Somebody. It needs a name."
Zinnia: "Fair." She doesn't come back.

events.name: The Founding: the Emblem
events.intro: The emblem. Eight shapes; green and gold.

success.text: A wing, in green and gold.
A ring, in green and gold.
A cloud, in green and gold.
The stick draws in the ash.

events.name: The Founding: the Emblem
events.intro: The emblem.

success.text: A star, in green and gold.
A feather, in green and gold.
An eye, in green and gold.
The stick draws in the ash.

events.name: The Founding: the Emblem
events.intro: The emblem.

success.text: A spire, in green and gold.
A kite, in green and gold.

events.name: The Founding: the Creed
events.intro: The creed. It can't be changed later, and it changes the story.

success.text: Neither land nor sea should win. Missions that stop both teams equally pay more Renown. Zinnia approves.
The towns and wild Pokémon in the way come first. Rescues pay more, and kindness counts double.
The sky should rule the other two. Raids pay more. Grunts are bolder and less loyal. Zinnia watches you closely.

events.name: The First Three
events.intro: Your first recruits aren't hired. They come. Marlo, the Aqua diver: "I found the trench. I know what's in it. I've not slept right since. I'd like to work for someone who's scared of it." Dr. Tuff, the Magma geologist: "My readings said it would kill everyone. He wouldn't look. Will you look?" The third is whoever you've been kindest to in Hoenn: the freed spy, if there is one; or, failing all else, a kid with a kite, Lowen, who heard there was a team with no hats.

success.text: Team Sky has three, and Zinnia, who'll come to the meetings and criticise. It meets on hills.

events.name: The Drill and the Dig
events.intro: Both teams are working the same coast, a mile apart: Magma's drill and Aqua's dig. Dr. Tuff: "If the drill reaches the vent, the dig floods with boiling water. Neither of them knows the other's there." Marlo: "There are grunts in that trench. Kids, mostly."

success.text: The other team finishes its job.
The other team finishes its job.
You walk into each camp in turn, in a green scarf, and tell them. Each lieutenant has to decide whether to believe an enemy. They do.
The vent blows. Nobody dies. Twenty grunts in both colours crawl out scalded and furious at their own leaders. Six of them ask to join Sky. Zinnia: "That was cold."

events.name: The Name on the Wall
events.intro: Somebody has painted the Sky emblem on a town hall. It wasn't you. The mayor: "Are you a gang? We've got two. We can't afford three." The painter is one of your own recruits, who wanted people to know.

success.text: You say it to the painter too. Team Sky's public face is proud: recruits come faster.
You find them. You tell them quietly. Team Sky's public face is quiet: Heat rises slower.
The painter helps. Team Sky's public face is quiet.

events.name: The First Loss
events.intro: A mission goes wrong. A grunt is captured by one of the teams. The team looks at you. Lowen: "We go and get them. Right? That's what we are?"

success.text: A Hideout raid, led by you.
You give up something for them. They come home.
The grunt is freed later, by Zinnia, who tells the team who came for them and who didn't.

events.name: Two Invitations
events.intro: Maxie, by letter: "Your organisation shows method. Ally with me against the sea, and I'll leave you the air. I've no use for it." Archie, in person, on your hill, with a barrel: "A third crew! I love it! Sail with me against the hot-heads and I'll name a ship after you."

success.text: Maxie writes back within the hour. It's a very precise letter.
Archie opens the barrel.
Both are offended in different ways.

choices.label: Tell each about the other's offer.

success.text: They're furious at each other, and wary of you.

events.name: The Base
events.intro: The team needs a home. Three sites, each with a cost.

success.text: Forecasts, and Dr. Cirra Hart as an ally. It's public. Everyone knows where Sky is.
Hidden, and a Rayquaza Sign site. It needs Zinnia's permission.
It moves. Missions launch from anywhere. Heat +4 with the team it's stolen from.

events.name: What Zinnia Wants
events.intro: Zinnia: "The tower's my grandmother's. You can have it. One condition." Zinnia: "When it comes to it, and it will, you don't call the dragon down for yourself. You call it for everyone, or not at all. Say it."

success.text: She nods once. She'll know.
Zinnia: "...Honest. I'll take honest."
Zinnia: "Then it's the only way for everyone. Say it, or don't."

events.name: The Lieutenant Who Wants More
events.intro: One of your Admins has been reading the Draconid murals. The Admin: "They can each wake one. We could wake the one that beats both. Why are we playing referee when we could be the whistle?" The Admin: "You'd be the most powerful person in Hoenn. You'd never have to ask anybody anything again."

success.text: They nod. If they're not loyal, they don't mean it.
They show you how.
They're demoted. A third of the boldest grunts leave with them, and found a splinter: the Zenith.

events.name: Mt. Pyre, From the Other Side
events.intro: The summit bench. The old couple. And below, climbing from two sides, a red column and a blue one. The old man: "You're new. No hat." The old woman: "A scarf. That's a hat for your neck." The old man: "They're coming for these. We can't stop two. Can you?"

success.text: Two battles, uphill, against both lieutenants.
Sky now holds both orbs. Every faction in Hoenn is after you.

choices.label: Give each team the wrong orb.

success.text: The swap, on purpose, to both. In the cavern, each legend will turn on the team that woke it.

choices.label: Let them have them. We stop it at the cavern.

success.text: The old woman: "That's a gamble with other people's coast."

events.name: The Red Column
events.intro: Tabitha, at the head of the red column. Tabitha: "Hoo... a scarf. Out of the way."

success.text: Uphill.

events.name: The Blue Column
events.intro: Shelly, at the head of the blue column. Shelly: "Ahaha! A third colour. How sweet. Move."

success.text: Uphill.

events.name: The Summit Held
events.intro: Your squads held the paths. The orbs stay in two laps.

success.text: The old man offers you a sweet.

events.name: The Zenith
events.intro: A splinter team in black-green, on Sky Pillar, trying to call it down for themselves. At the front: your own old lieutenant.

success.text: The Admin: "I learned it from watching you. I just didn't stop where you stopped."

events.name: The Sky's Choice
events.intro: The Seafloor Cavern. Both leaders. Both legends, waking. And a green-scarfed line between them. Maxie: "You. The referee." Archie: "The kite club! You've got some nerve!" Zinnia, behind you, quietly: "Here it is. This is the bit in the story." The sky above the cavern roof has gone the colour of a bruise. Something up there is listening.

success.text: You don't use an orb. You ask.
You raise a hand, and it comes, and it isn't asking.
You walk out onto the rock between two waking legends, with the whole team behind, and no orb, and no dragon.
"Lilycove. Both of you. Say it."

events.name: Call It for Everyone
events.intro: Rayquaza comes down through the storm like a line being drawn. It looks at the two below. It looks at you. It waits to be told, and isn't. Zinnia: "You didn't order it. ...It noticed." Both legends sleep. Rayquaza leaves. Team Sky becomes a standing watch: a hut on every high place in Hoenn, a kite flying when the weather's wrong.

success.text: Zinnia's trust is at its highest.

events.name: Call It for Us
events.intro: The Admin: "Yes. Yes." Zinnia: "You said it. You said it to my face." Rayquaza ends the fight in a single turn, and stays. Hoenn's sky belongs to you. Both old teams kneel or flee. Every town flies the emblem, because it must. Zinnia leaves, and takes the Draconid tower with her.

success.text: It's still there.
The Promise is broken. She'll battle you, now.

events.name: Call It for Us
events.intro: Hoenn's sky is yours. Your rival's last battle of the run will be fought on Sky Pillar, to make you let it go.

success.text: Every town flies the emblem.

events.name: A Broken Promise
events.intro: Her Salamence, and a fury the game hasn't shown before.

success.text: Whatever the result, she doesn't come back.

events.name: Stand Between Them
events.intro: Lowen, voice cracking: "This is so stupid. I'm staying." Five turns between Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre, taking hits meant for each other. Every Sky grunt who's loyal enough stands one turn in your place.

success.text: It holds for five turns. Both leaders are looking at a hundred people in green who are willing to be the thing in the way, and it's that, not force, that stops them. Maxie: "...Stand down. All units. Stand down." Archie: "Drop anchor. Drop it! I said drop it!"

failure.text: It bends, and doesn't break. Your party takes the hits nobody else could. Nobody faints from it. It holds for five turns. Maxie: "...Stand down. All units. Stand down." Archie: "Drop anchor. Drop it! I said drop it!"

events.name: Stand Between Them
events.intro: Nobody dies. Renown at its highest.

success.text: Every Pokémon that held the line is closer to you for it.

events.name: Make Them Talk
events.intro: Maxie and Archie look at each other. Something they've spent twenty years not saying is in the room. Archie: "...You were on that street." Maxie: "You were on that pier." They grew up three streets apart. The same wave, the same year. One blamed the sea; one blamed the people who built on it. Shelly and Tabitha, who've both walked out by now, stand at the back with their arms folded, like parents at a school play. The orbs go back up Mt. Pyre in two hands that have never touched before.

success.text: It's dissolved by its own success. Nothing woke at all.

choices.label: Keep it, as the Hoenn Weather Watch.

success.text: A red wing and a blue wing. Nothing woke at all.
